what: Everest Group is a Bermuda-based reinsurer and insurer. Most of its business is reinsurance, taking a share of other insurers' property and casualty risk, and it also writes specialty insurance directly.
customers: Insurance companies buying reinsurance, and businesses buying specialty insurance directly.
money: property catastrophe, casualty and specialty reinsurance
moat: Capital and a long underwriting record that let it write large catastrophe risks few competitors can absorb, and the discipline to shrink when prices are inadequate.
risks: Reserve strengthening in US casualty lines hurt recent results
Catastrophe losses can be very large in any single year
Reinsurance pricing has softened after several strong years
opportunities: Revenue grew about 13% a year over three years
Higher interest rates raise investment income on its large portfolio
A dividend yield near 2% with a record of growing book value per share
watch: The combined ratio, particularly casualty reserve development.
